items.title: Measuring What You Can't Click - Metrics for AI Visibility in the Automotive Aftermarket
items.summary: Presented at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.Search didn’t die. Clicks did. Google search volume is as strong as ever, but in June 2026 only 40% of searches ended with a click to a site outside Google, a record low. Add AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, and a growing share of buyers are researching parts, comparing brands and picking installers without ever landing on your website. Your products may be winning in AI results and your dashboard would never show it.This session unpacks the measurement problem the automotive aftermarket is walking into and what to do about it:What actually changed, and what didn’t. Search is still where buyers research. The purchase happens somewhere else, and the research step is increasingly a no-click step.Why AI ranking tools can’t deliver what they promise. Ask an AI the same question 100 times and you’ll get a different list almost every time. Ranking position in AI isn’t a meaningful metric. Visibility percentage is.Mentioned vs. cited. Your product almost always shows up in the answer. The question is whether AI is pulling from your site or from a retailer listing, a forum thread or a YouTube video you didn’t make.A six-dimension readiness assessment that brands, e-commerce sellers and shops can score themselves against: discovery awareness, information accuracy, brand representation, technical readiness, measurement evolution and stakeholder communication.The clicks that still happen. How to segment higher-intent AI referral traffic in GA4 and connect it to real-world signals like quote requests, dealer inquiries, marketplace sales and the phone ringing.Three actions to run this week and how to explain all of it to your boss, your sales team or the owner before someone asks why traffic is down.The readiness assessment, the step-by-step GA4 tutorial and the research referenced in the session are all on the resources page: blacktruckmedia.com/sema-measuring-what-you-cant-clickPresented by Jason Dodge, founder of BlackTruck Media + Marketing, a Michigan-based search and AI visibility agency trusted by brands to improve how they show up when and where customers are looking for them. Specializing in technical SEO, paid media, data analytics and generative AI search. Connect with Jason on LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/in/dodgejd
